en.title: God of War TV Show Recasts Kratos After Actor's On-Set Injury
en.summary: Amazon's highly anticipated God of War series faces a significant setback as lead actor Ryan Hurst has been recast due to an on-set injury. Production is set to resume soon with a new face in the iconic role of Kratos.
en.body:
## Kratos Undergoes a Major Change

Fans of **Amazon's** upcoming *God of War* television series have received surprising news: the role of the Spartan warrior **Kratos** will be recast. Actor **Ryan Hurst**, known for his roles in *Sons of Anarchy* and as the voice of Thor in *God of War: Ragnarök*, suffered a bicep tear during a stunt on set. This injury has led to a significant production reset, with anonymous sources indicating that Hurst has undergone surgery and is recovering.

The decision to recast comes after **Hurst** had reportedly undergone a physical transformation, gaining 40 pounds of muscle specifically for the demanding role. Given the physically intensive nature of playing **Kratos** and the necessity of working closely with a child actor who is reportedly in every scene, the studios, Sony Pictures Television and Amazon MGM Studios, have opted to restart with a new actor to maintain production schedules. Four episodes had already been wrapped, meaning those scenes will need to be re-shot.

## Fan Reactions and Production Hurdles

The initial reveal of **Hurst** as **Kratos** generated mixed reactions among the fanbase, and this recasting means he won't have the opportunity to win over any remaining skeptics. The injury underscores the inherent risks in bringing such a visceral game world to life. For viewers who have followed the *God of War* saga from its PlayStation origins, seeing the face of **Kratos** change so late in production is a jarring development. The franchise has always been lauded for its brutal combat and epic boss battles, and translating that physicality to live-action is a monumental task that clearly comes with its own set of challenges.

The pause in production, which began shortly after the injury, is expected to end with a restart planned for mid-October. This swift timeline suggests that **Amazon** is eager to get back on track, with the search for **Kratos**'s replacement likely already underway. Fans will undoubtedly be scrutinizing casting announcements closely, hoping for an actor who can embody the stoic rage and underlying pathos of the Ghost of Sparta.

## What Comes Next for the Spartan

While **Ryan Hurst** will no longer be portraying **Kratos**, he is still attached to other projects, including a role in Christopher Nolan's new *Odyssey* film. The identity of the actor stepping into **Kratos**'s boots for the **Amazon** series has not yet been announced, but given the reported production restart date, details are expected to emerge soon. The setback, while significant, is a reminder of the complex journey involved in adapting beloved video game properties for the screen.

es.title: El dios de la guerra: el reparto de Kratos sufre un cambio inesperado
es.summary: La serie de Amazon basada en el popular videojuego God of War sufre un revés importante debido a una lesión de su actor principal, Ryan Hurst. La producción se reanudará pronto con un nuevo rostro en el papel del icónico Kratos. La noticia ha generado una gran expectación entre los fans, que esperan con ansias el anuncio del nuevo actor que interpretará al guerrero espartano.
es.body:
## Un cambio inesperado para Kratos

Los fans de la próxima serie de televisión de Amazon basada en God of War han recibido una noticia sorprendente: el papel de Kratos será reinterpretado por un nuevo actor. El actor Ryan Hurst, conocido por sus papeles en Sons of Anarchy y como la voz de Thor en God of War: Ragnarök, sufrió una lesión en el set durante una escena de acción. Esta lesión ha llevado a un reinicio significativo de la producción, con fuentes anónimas que indican que Hurst se ha sometido a una cirugía y se está recuperando.

La decisión de reemplazar a Hurst se debe a que el actor había experimentado una transformación física para el papel, ganando 40 libras de músculo específicamente para el exigente papel de Kratos. Dado el carácter físicamente intenso de interpretar a Kratos y la necesidad de trabajar en estrecha colaboración con un actor infantil que está en casi todas las escenas, los estudios, Sony Pictures Television y Amazon MGM Studios, han optado por reiniciar la producción con un nuevo actor para mantener los plazos de producción. Ya se habían grabado cuatro episodios, lo que significa que esas escenas tendrán que ser rehechas.

## Reacciones de los fans y obstáculos de producción

La revelación inicial de Hurst como Kratos generó reacciones mixtas entre los fans, y este recasting significa que no tendrá la oportunidad de ganarse a los escépticos. La lesión subraya los riesgos inherentes a la hora de llevar un mundo de juego tan visceral a la vida real. Para los espectadores que han seguido la saga de God of War desde sus orígenes en PlayStation, ver el rostro de Kratos cambiar tan tarde en la producción es un desarrollo impactante. La franquicia siempre ha sido elogiada por sus combates brutales y batallas épicas, y traducir esa physicalidad a acción en vivo es una tarea monumental que claramente conlleva sus propios desafíos.

La pausa en la producción, que comenzó poco después de la lesión, se espera que termine con un reinicio planeado para mediados de octubre. Este cronograma sugiere que Amazon está ansioso por volver a la pista, con la búsqueda del reemplazo de Kratos probablemente ya en marcha. Los fans sin duda estarán observando de cerca los anuncios de casting, esperando a un actor que pueda encarnar la rabia estoica y la patología subyacente del Ghost of Sparta.

## ¿Qué viene a continuación para el espartano?

Aunque Ryan Hurst ya no interpretará a Kratos, todavía está vinculado a otros proyectos, incluido un papel en la nueva película de Christopher Nolan, Odyssey. La identidad del actor que se pondrá en los zapatos de Kratos para la serie de Amazon aún no ha sido anunciada, pero dado el fecha de reinicio de la producción informada, se espera que los detalles salgan a la luz pronto. El contratiempo, aunque significativo, es un recordatorio del viaje complejo involucrado en la adaptación de propiedades de videojuegos queridas para la pantalla.

content_raw: Remember that photo which stirred all sorts of talk about Amazon's upcoming God of War TV series? Well, the show won't look like that anymore—the role of Kratos is set to be recast since actor Ryan Hurst tore a bicep on set, according to Deadline . Anonymous sources in that story claim Hurst has had surgery and is recovering. As Deadline points out, this comes after Hurst "underwent a physical transformation" and put on 40 pounds of muscle specifically to play Kratos. But for such a physical role and with a child actor (who's in every scene with the character, one assumes) to consider, it seems starting over is the simplest way forward for Amazon. Production paused right after the injury and is planned to restart by mid-October with someone new in the role. In other words, any scenes that have already been shot will have to be redone—with four episodes already wrapped, that's a huge reset. After a mixed reaction to that initial photo, Hurst won't get the chance to prove his naysayers wrong in the end. Hurst is also in Christopher Nolan's new Odyssey movie as Mentor, and theater-avoidant gamers may know him as Thor in God of War: Ragnarok or Beta in AMC's Walking Dead series. It's not clear who will take his place, but given the reported production schedule, we won't be waiting long to find out.
